Russian II is harder than I expected. I struggle a lot and considered withdrawing from this course but if I considered giving up every time I thought that English is hard then I wouldn't learn a single word. That's why my suggestion for this course if you're not willing to face hardships don't take it because most probably you'll lose one of your withdrawn chances. Yet if you are eager to learn Russian, it is really enjoyable to figure things out.
